clue.text: Someone who is out of his class

definitions.text: Someone who is out of his class

parts.words: Someone who is out of his class
parts.note: reads like a person socially out of place, but means a pupil absent from the classroom without leave

explanation.surface: A social climber who doesn't belong among the people around him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of his class' suggests social rank; the school sense is a pupil skipping lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: A pupil skipping school without permission is absent from the lesson.

clue.text: Note long run for the master

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
to long for something is to ache for it
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A musical note held for a long run, played for the master.
explanation.definitionFit: A schoolmaster is a teacher; the word was once the usual name for one.

clue.text: No wages? With the Communist back in, still not enough money

indicators.note: in signals that one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: work with no wages is unpaid

indicators.note: back means the word for the Communist is read in reverse

parts.note: a Red is a Communist

explanation.surface: A worker grumbling that even with the Communists returned to power, the pay is too low.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns RED into DER, which 'in' puts inside UNPAID.
explanation.definitionFit: Being paid too little means getting less money than is due, still short.

clue.text: Do teachers look up to such a rat?

parts.note: the NUT was the National Union of Teachers

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for look is read from bottom to top

parts.note: an air is a look or appearance someone has

explanation.surface: A question whether schoolteachers admire a particular rodent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns AIR to RIA beneath NUT; the NUT is a British teachers' union.
explanation.definitionFit: The coypu, a large South American water rodent, is also called by this name.

clue.text: Bloomer to swallow heroin of the first grade

indicators.note: to swallow means the flower's name takes the drug's letter inside it

parts.note: a bloomer here is a flowering plant, and the campion is one
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: A gardening blunder involving drugs at a top school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' reads as a mistake but is a flower, the campion, which swallows H.
explanation.definitionFit: A top-class winner is the best in the field, first-rate.

clue.text: Dwell tediously on the instrument

definitions.meaning: to ... on a subject is to keep going on about it
a large stringed instrument played by plucking

explanation.surface: Someone going on and on about a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep returning to a topic tiresomely is to harp on it; the harp is also a plucked stringed instrument.

clue.text: Mother or I can cook pasta

parts.note: ma is a familiar word for mother

indicators.note: cook means the letters are worked over and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A family deciding whether Mum or I will make the pasta.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cook' shuffles MA with ORICAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Tube-shaped dried pasta made from durum wheat.

clue.text: Soldier comes back to game of cards at the house

indicators.note: comes back means the soldier's letters go in reverse

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier
loo is an old card game

explanation.surface: A soldier returning home for an evening of cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes back' turns GI into IG; LOO is also British slang for a lavatory, which helps the misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: A domed Inuit dwelling built from blocks of snow.

clue.text: Over ten go to law about a thousand Japanese ornaments

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the word ten is turned upwards

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: about means the word for go to law surrounds the letter

parts.note: to sue is to go to law
K stands for a thousand

explanation.surface: A dispute over ten items ending in a lawsuit about a thousand Japanese trinkets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over' turns TEN into NET; 'about' puts K inside SUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Small carved toggles worn on a kimono sash; the plural is spelled the same.

clue.text: Checks car on way back

parts.note: an Audi is a make of car

indicators.note: back means the abbreviation for way is reversed

parts.note: St is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: A driver examining their car on the way back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns ST into TS.
explanation.definitionFit: Inspections of accounts or procedures are examinations of them.

clue.text: Couple allowed an armband

parts.note: a brace is a pair or couple
let means allowed

explanation.surface: A pair permitted to wear an armband.
explanation.definitionFit: A band of jewellery worn round the wrist encircles the arm.

clue.text: Cold church houses a sailor on the run

indicators.note: houses means the church abbreviation holds the other letters inside

parts.note: a tar is a sailor
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A chilly church sheltering a fugitive sailor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'houses' puts A, TAR and R inside CH; 'on the' is a link to the run.
explanation.definitionFit: A head cold brings mucus and inflammation of the nose and throat.

clue.text: Old battleaxe needed two men, we're told

indicators.note: we're told means the names are heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: Harry and Dan are two men's names

explanation.surface: A fierce old woman needing two men to deal with her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we're told' signals that HARRY DAN said aloud gives the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A battleaxe is a bossy, aggressive old woman, a shrew.

clue.text: Gold leaf will transform room adding lustre without rest being disturbed

indicators.note: adding joins the next piece on after the first
will transform means the letters of room are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: without means letters are taken out of lustre

parts.note: taken as written
the letters of rest, disturbed into the order they have inside lustre

explanation.surface: A recipe for gilding a room to give it sheen without disturbing anyone's sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will transform' turns ROOM into ORMO; LUSTRE 'without' the letters of REST, jumbled to STRE ('being disturbed'), leaves LU.
explanation.definitionFit: Gilded bronze, used on furniture, is a gold-coloured decorative finish.

clue.text: Church not initially certain to get the blame

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: initially means only the first letter of not is used

parts.note: sure means certain

explanation.surface: A church unsure of itself being held responsible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not initially' reads as 'not at first' but gives N, the first letter of 'not'.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal disapproval or reproof is criticism laid on someone.

clue.text: Managed to catch old horse

indicators.note: to catch means the word for managed closes round the letter

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it, so ran means managed

explanation.surface: Someone succeeding in catching an aged horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse whose coat is mixed with white hairs is described by this colour.

clue.text: Can't a rebel be converted in a place of worship?

indicators.note: be converted means the letters are changed into a new order, with a religious hint

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Asking whether a rebel can find faith in a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be converted' rearranges CANTAREBEL.
explanation.definitionFit: The portable sanctuary of the Israelites, and later any chapel or meeting house for worship.

clue.text: Accountant in company has trumped up row

parts.note: CA is a chartered accountant
phony means false or trumped up

explanation.surface: A firm's accountant accused of inventing a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A row here is a din, a harsh jumble of noise.

clue.text: Sword of honour

parts.note: points to the tap of a sword on the shoulder when a knighthood is conferred

explanation.surface: A ceremonial sword awarded for distinction.
explanation.definitionFit: The touch of a sword in knighting is a mark of honour, and now any award or praise.

clue.text: Delilah, for instance, had half educated accent as a cover

indicators.note: as a cover means the word for accent wraps around the other piece

parts.note: stress on a syllable is an accent

indicators.note: half means only the first four of the eight letters of educated are used

explanation.surface: A biblical temptress whose half-learned accent hid her real nature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half' takes EDUC from 'educated'; 'as a cover' puts it inside STRESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Delilah enticed Samson to betray his secret, a classic temptress.

clue.text: Vessel for Russian charlady?

parts.note: charlady suggests a cleaning woman, but char is also British slang for tea, so the vessel is a Russian tea urn

explanation.surface: A ship carrying a Russian cleaning lady.
explanation.walkthrough: CHAR is British slang for tea and a charlady is a cleaner; the clue reads 'lady' as a hint at the char in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A Russian urn keeps water hot for brewing tea.

clue.text: Like a lemon, I'd hold on to the bill

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone sour about a bill they must hang on to.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemon tastes sharp and sour, with a low pH.

clue.text: Rids the doctor of quaking fits

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A physician curing patients of shaking attacks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doctor' looks like a noun but is the verb rearranging RIDSTHE.
explanation.definitionFit: Being all of a quiver, nervous agitation, is being in a state of nerves.

clue.text: At first summer camp I discovered prawns

indicators.note: at first means only the first letter of summer is used

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A child reporting what they found on the menu at summer camp.
explanation.definitionFit: Large shellfish, usually fried in breadcrumbs, as served in British pubs.

clue.text: One who counsels conservationists to be more active outside

indicators.note: outside means the rearranged letters go round the abbreviation
active means the letters of more are set in motion and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
the NT is the National Trust, a British conservation body

explanation.surface: An adviser urging environmentalists to step up their campaigning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'active' turns MORE into ME...OR, split 'outside' NT.
explanation.definitionFit: An experienced adviser who guides a less experienced person.

clue.text: Only another name for the yarn

indicators.note: another means a different arrangement of the letters

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A claim that something is merely a fancy label for thread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' rearranges ONLY with N.
explanation.definitionFit: A synthetic fibre spun into thread for fabric and stockings.

clue.text: Crazy to take drug after drug

indicators.note: after means the second drug follows the first

parts.note: crack is a form of cocaine
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: A warning that taking one drug after another sends you mad.
explanation.definitionFit: An eccentric person with mad ideas; used as an adjective it means lunatic.

clue.text: Depressed athlete

definitions.meaning: a sportsman who has represented Oxford or Cambridge University

explanation.surface: A sportsman feeling low.
explanation.walkthrough: At Oxford and Cambridge, someone chosen for the university team is awarded a 'blue'.
explanation.definitionFit: Being down in the dumps is feeling glum; an Oxbridge sporting representative is also called this.

clue.text: Virginia a left university with a skill that was worth money

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
having a skill makes one able

explanation.surface: A Virginian student who left university with a lucrative talent.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'a' after Virginia and 'with' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of great price or importance commands a high price.

clue.text: Semi-disposed to accept Post Office burden

indicators.note: to accept means the jumbled letters take the abbreviation inside
disposed means the letters of semi are arranged in a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A half-willing person agreeing to take on postal duties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Semi-disposed' looks like 'half-inclined'; 'disposed' rearranges SEMI to IMSE, which takes PO inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay a duty or tax on someone is to load them with it.

clue.text: Clarified how to tear deer apart?

parts.note: to rend is to tear

indicators.note: apart means the letters of deer are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A grisly question about how to rip a deer to pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'apart' turns DEER into ERED.
explanation.definitionFit: Melting fat down to purify it is the cooking sense, as with clarified butter.

clue.text: Underhand bishop is coming back to the prophets

indicators.note: coming back means the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: sly means underhand or sneaky
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A devious bishop returning to consult the prophets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' reverses SLY, B and IS together.
explanation.definitionFit: Women seers of the ancient world who foretold the future.
